name: Watch CI after bump
command: cd /home/tonio/project/recipes && sleep 15 && RUN=$(gh run list -R antoinelucasfra/cookbook --limit 1 --json databaseId --jq '.[0].databaseId') && gh run watch $RUN -R antoinelucasfra/cookbook --exit-status --interval 20 > /tmp/deploy-watch2.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?" >> /tmp/deploy-watch2.log; grep -c 'deprecated' /tmp/deploy-watch2.log >> /tmp/deploy-watch2.log; tail -3 /tmp/deploy-watch2.log
